full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal J : This appeal by leave by defendant No. 1 is from the judgment and order dated the 28th August. 1990 passed by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.712 of 1990 upholding the concurrent judgments and decrees of the Courts below dated 6.1.90 and 29.7.84 respectively passed in Title Appeal No. 336 of 1984 by the 1st Court of Additional District Judge. Dhaka and Title Suit No. 3 of 1984 by the learned Subordinate Judge and Commercial Court No. 2. Dhaka, decreeing the plaintiff-respondents, suit. 

 6. On the aforesaid amongst other allegations the plaintiff-respondents filed the present suit praying for a decree declaring that the aforesaid Rules of 1980 circulated by the appellant by Memo dated 23.8.80 and the procedure for establishment of the said Rules vide Memo dated 27.9.80 and the office order dated 3.2.81 and Notification dated 16.5.81 are illegal, void, inoperative, ultra vires, without lawful authority and of no legal effect. 

 8. As already noticed the trial court decreed the suit and on appeal the court of Appeal below affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court. In revision the High Court Division refused to interfere with the same.
